title.title: Job title
title.description: The job title as posted on the source site.

company.title: Company
company.description: Hiring company name, or "Not listed" if the site didn't show one.

location.title: Location
location.description: Job location as shown on the listing.

description.title: Description
description.description: Snippet from the listing, if the site's search results include one. Usually "No description" since most search-result cards don't show a snippet.

postedDate.title: Posted date
postedDate.description: Relative or absolute posting date/time as shown on the listing.

url.title: URL
url.description: Direct link to the job posting.

source.title: Source
source.description: Which job site this listing came from, e.g. "LinkedIn".

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Which search keyword produced this result.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this listing was scraped.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Job listings across all selected sites and keywords.
